approved_state_rule: Approved master data changes only after an explicit Approve Update action.
approval_binding_rule: Approve only the exact pending run ID that was successfully refreshed, displayed, and reviewed in Excel.
stale_review_rule: If exchange export or refresh fails, do not open or announce an older review table as current.
identifier_preservation_rule: Import exchange CSV fields as text unless the engine contract explicitly declares a non-identifier typed field.
source_file_hyperlink_rule: Every table column that identifies a source workbook must be converted to a clickable Excel hyperlink resolved against the selected Data Folder.
user_input_rule: Use Excel checkboxes for genuine binary owner choices when practical, especially include/exclude source scope. Use dropdown lists for mutually exclusive choices with three or more meanings. Keep explanatory comments/notes as free text. Avoid dense checkbox controls on large extraction tables where they would reduce performance or readability.
source_selection_rule: Source Selection uses one Excel checkbox per source workbook. Checked means included in index scope; unchecked means owner-excluded. Checkbox changes are batched and applied only when Save Selection & Restage is pressed. Source files are never edited or deleted by this choice.
review_flag_workflow_rule: Review Flags uses native Select? checkboxes plus explicit Source File and Worksheet Name columns. Parser-fix reports are written to sequential PARSER_FIX_REPORTS/NNNN folders and explicitly saved to the staged-run audit trail.
technical_conflicts_rule: Non-overridable technical conflicts must be corrected and restaged before approval.
dynamic_rules_rule: Business classifications and mappings must be user-editable in Excel and synchronized to engine configuration without source-code edits.
